          SELECT *

          WHERE date_issued > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'

sql_templates.description: Fetches the most recent 5 sessions' data including enhanced runs, filtered stocks, and stage snapshots.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, run_ts
    FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts >= (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM report.enhanced_runs) - INTERVAL '5 days'
), 
latest_filtered_stocks AS (
    SELECT efs.run_id, efs.symbol, efs.score
    FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks efs
    INNER JOIN latest_runs lr ON efs.run_id = lr.run_id
), 
latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, stage_score
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT lr.run_id, efs.symbol, efs.score, ss.stage, ss.stage_score
FROM latest_filtered_stocks efs
LEFT JOIN latest_snapshots ss ON efs.symbol = ss.symbol
LEFT JOIN latest_runs lr ON efs.run_id = lr.run_id;
